title: Elegy to a Missing Friend
overview: In the aftermath of her friend's passing, an artist processes her grief by making a film. She weaves her personal archival footage and an unfinished science-fiction narrative into a deeply raw and emotive work of art.

title: The Bluey Movie
overview: On an action-packed day, a big surprise changes everything for Bluey and her family.

title: To Bontang
overview: She is worth every mile, every inch, and every heartbeat.

title: Rattakus
overview: After a rebellion is crushed by the rats in the sewers of Los Santos, the rats return to a mostly peaceful life until Rattakus is forced to make a difficult decision that will change the fate of every rat in Los Santos.

title: Wings of Freedom
overview: Home-loving eagle Salana is forced out of her jungle bird colony to join Pirro, an intrepid swift and member of the Animal Air Force. This unlikely duo embarks on an epic, high-flying adventure to stop a malevolent AI and save the world.

title: Dive 2: The Journey Continues
overview: Vignesh, a skilled swimmer, thinks winning in the pool is all he needs for success. But when his teammate Aanya quits swimming to focus on studies, he starts rethinking his choices. Struggling with school and swimming, Vignesh feels lost until his mom encourages him to find balance. With hard work, he improves in both and learns that real success comes from giving your best in all areas of life.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog 4
overview: Sonic the Hedgehog, joined by a new hero named Amy, faces a new technological nemesis known as Metal Sonic.

title: Panic Carefully
overview: Described as a paranoid thriller about a hunt for a cyber-terrorist in the vein of Mr. Robot and The Silence of the Lambs.

title: The Third Parent
overview: A neighborhood Fourth of July celebration is interrupted by a ferociously bizarre anomaly who overpowers a family in order to teach them how to become better people and more compliant citizens.

title: The Curse of the Silver Chain
original_title: The Curse of the Silver Chain
overview: A silver chain that appears for centuries made by warlocks in the 15th century.

title: The Inmate
overview: About an inmate who fears the outside world.

At 8:38 PM, May wakes up in a room with no memory. With one lifeline call, she must uncover the truth, before it’s too late. But is the voice helping her… or hiding something darker? 8 minutes is all she has.

title: Focker-in-Law
overview: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, faces family chaos when he decides to marry a strong-willed woman who appears to be his complete mismatch.

title: The Last Temptation of Becky
overview: Working as a CIA field agent, Becky is sent undercover to Poland to infiltrate a family of innkeepers running a tourist venture at The Wolf’s Lair, Hitler’s WWII bunker. After learning that the father, Wilhelm Reuss, is on a mission to bring about the Fourth Reich, Becky takes matters into her own hands.

title: Clayface
overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

title: Wuthering Heights: The House of the Damned
original_title: Wuthering Heights: The House of the Damned
overview: Mr. Lockwood arrives at the remote and storm-battered Wuthering Heights, unaware that Catherine's vengeful ghost walks its halls. Her obsessed lover, Heathcliff, feeds her bloodlust with human sacrifice, hoping to give her soul a new body to inhabit. As Lockwood grows sick and delusional, he is drawn deeper into their deadly, undying love, and must escape before he becomes their next victim.

title: Run Terry Run
overview: The extraordinary story of Canadian icon Terry Fox will be told like never before in Run Terry Run, a new feature-length documentary directed by acclaimed filmmaker Sean Menard. The film offers an intimate, behind-the-scenes look at Terry’s legendary 1980 Marathon of Hope, drawing from 96 reels of never-before-seen footage and unheard audio interviews that have remained untouched for 45 years.

title: Other Mommy
overview: A young girl, Bela, forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home who looks uncannily like her own mother.

title: Artificial
overview: An undercover cop is assigned to monitor a humanoid robot, but an unexpected bond over art leads to a final task: creating a painting.

title: Sense and Sensibility
overview: An irresistible new take on Jane Austen’s iconic Sense and Sensibility: a charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.

title: Ghost Buddies: The Gathering
overview: A group of friends gather for a birthday weekend in a "rented" house that's haunted. Their ghost-hunting friend, Connor, secretly seeks a possessed plush toy, causing chaos. He must find and exorcise the toy without alerting his friends.

title: Brandon & Haider
overview: When the enigmatic allure of two ancient artifacts is unleashed, two students are bestowed with unparalleled powers. Yet, a relentless collector, driven by an insatiable thirst for dominion, will stop at nothing to seize them, igniting a cataclysmic battle that will determine the fate of worlds

title: 32 Frames: A 9/11 Mystery
overview: A journalist receives 32 new photos of 9/11 from a camera found in the rubble of the World Trade Center — and uses clues in each frame to ID the photographer.

title: Junction Row
overview: Juno is a recovering addict who leaves a fringe housing compound for a better life, leaving her beloved Ruby behind. When she learns that Ruby has gone missing, Juno returns, only to find Junction Row has become a hotbed of criminal activity, but she encounters much more than menacing drug dealers on her mission to find Ruby.

title: Doorman
overview: On a first date, a young woman gets herself entangled with a man who is desperate to stay in her life no matter how far he has to go.

title: American Martyr: The Stanley Rother Story
original_title: American Martyr: The Stanley Rother Story
overview: After struggling with his studies in the seminary, a young priest from Oklahoma discerns his call to serve Guatemala’s native people, no matter the cost. Hosted by Fr. Charles Connor.

title: The House
overview: After a heart attack, Jovan, a retired architect of Serbian origin who spent most of his life in Germany, refuses to give into his daughter's pressure to spend the rest of his life in a nursing home. With his grandson Nikola, who has Asperger's syndrome and is living without social contacts, he travels to his homeland, a village in Serbia, to sell the family land, but becomes a part of a local population rebellion against the construction mafia that threatens to destroy everything that is left of his homeland.

title: Coyote vs. Acme
overview: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

title: Garchaster's Cornblade
overview: A gricky star planet girl follows a casting call into the Earth oven so she can fulfill her dream of getting inside of a VHS tape... to burn and inhale herself. Donald Farmer weaves golden webs with the cryogenic cowboys while the star planet gets heavier with razzling trash carnivals. The Carpet Muckers twirling gorches but the Garbites are way too hungry for karaoke flavored peanut butter screams.

title: Meeting Marsha
overview: An aspiring actress must put her marriage proposal on pause to her comedian girlfriend, when her biological mother and infamous TV star, Marsha Davis, wants to finally meet. What should be a lovely and unforgettable weekend, turns more nightmarish than anyone could have ever expected.

title: Pen to Paper
overview: A young man struggles to write a legible, heartfelt letter to his mum by hand.

title: Ever After
overview: A group of girlfriends arrive at a forest lodge to celebrate, but things take a horrific turn as they realize that the forest is home to bloodthirsty lunatics who perceive themselves to be characters from classic fairy tales.

title: Unruly
overview: When the responsibilities of tending to a haunted house are forced upon young Sam, she must fight to survive as she completes nightly tasks to keep the unruly spirits in her home satisfied.

title: Puppy
overview: When a woman returns to her childhood home to care for her father, the stuffed animal from her past-once a source of comfort-becomes a haunting conduit for unresolved grief, guilt, and the terrifying possibility that a past family tragedy is repeating itself in the present.

title: Eramus
overview: After a romantic interest vanishes without explanation, a woman becomes convinced he is dead. With only her phone as a companion, her katabasis through online spaces leads her to new spiritual languages emerging in a technological age.

title: At Night
overview: Six women in Paris traverse the neon-soaked anxiety of the city after dark.

title: Tight Lettuce
overview: A son films his father's addiction, hoping to document his recovery; but as he sacrifices everything to save him, he must decide how much he'll lose for someone who may not want saving.

title: Before Never
overview: When Wendy Darling escapes an attempted abduction, her family employs James and Smee to identify the attacker with the help of the only eyewitness: Peter Pan.

title: Subterranean
overview: An nihilistic, self deprecating, egotistical young man, bumps into an old acquaintance who invites him to a gathering leading to his eventual demise.

title: The Messenger
overview: In 1800s Fiji, Kaliti must battle both man & nature to save her village from impending doom.

title: The Lift
overview: The world's first film shot entirely inside an elevator, from the brilliant mind of Sexocracy author Luca Redavid. Bologna, August 2, 1980. A terrifying roar shakes the central station, while six strangers remain trapped in a cabin just steps from hell. Isolated from the world in a claustrophobic space of just a few square meters, tensions rise to the limit as air runs out and help fails to arrive...

title: Letter To Celestial
overview: Letter to Celestial is a re-animation and re-imagination of archival documents found in the search for Asian sex workers in Montréal's Chinatown and historic Red Light District.

title: Little Miss Fortune
overview: A young journalist must find a story in Belfast before midnight or lose his job.

title: Toast to Italy
overview: Jenny travels to Italy for a special bottle of wine for her sister's wedding. She meets Arrigo, also looking for the famous "Love Wine" and together their search leads to a love of their own.

title: The Boy
overview: A transgender woman searches a Cornish coastal town for a lost boy but quickly finds herself in a race against the Law.

title: Larger than Life
overview: A documentary following Connor Sanderson, the inspirational coach of Salisbury Ladies FC. Born with sacral agenesis, Connor has overcome physical challenges to pursue his passion for football, becoming a respected coach and an inspiration to his players and community.

title: Robotica
overview: Two security guards working the midnight shift in an adult toy company find themselves the target of a half-dismantled and severely malfunctioning female sex doll prototype named Robotica.

title: FANGS! The Musical
overview: A lonely vampire tries to return to the world, but is thrust into a world that has moved on without him.

title: Detention
overview: When four high schoolers get “Saturday Detention”, they quickly realize things just got a whole lot worse when they discover what they thought was just a waste-of-time detention turns into a bit of a nightmare… Group Therapy!

title: Void
overview: A man falls into a void and must return to the light.

title: Soulm8te
overview: After a ruthless tech giant acquires a small robotics company, a grieving engineer is tasked with testing their new AI companion. But when he attempts to reprogram her to be a truly sentient soulmate, she develops needs of her own—unleashing a relentless spree of precision-engineered mayhem.

title: Dead & Breakfast
overview: A paranormal consultant, Danielle Stanbreaker,  investigates a strange supernatural occurrence at a local Bed and Breakfast that ultimately ends up being real.

title: Comparable
overview: A Writer struggles to tap into his imagination as another, younger Writer shows off in front of him.

title: Snoopy Presents: There's No Place Like Home, Snoopy
original_title: Snoopy Presents: There's No Place Like Home, Snoopy
overview: When Snoopy's beloved doghouse goes missing, he tries to track it down, and learns what makes a house feel like home.

title: The Two Year Rule
overview: On the way to a cottage weekend with friends, a couple’s drive takes an unexpected turn when a passing cemetery stirs unresolved tensions.

title: Bruised Sky
overview: In early ‘70s rural England, George and Tommy, two teenaged friends-of-a-friend, meet up on an Essex basketball court. One invites the other to accompany him to a dealer’s home to score some weed.

title: Bagman
overview: A graduate researcher monitoring wildlife cameras notices a garbage bag suddenly appear in a forest clearing. She sends her senior technician to check it out--watching his every move through the live camera feed.

title: Wham! 10 Days in China
overview: In 1985, WHAM! made history as the first Western pop act to perform in communist China. George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley’s concerts in Beijing and Guangzhou were a cultural milestone – East meets West, music meets politics. Now, newly restored footage reveals the untold story of the iconic tour that helped launch WHAM! to global superstardom.

title: George Michael: The Trojan Souls
overview: The conversation that never finished.  In 1993, Andros Georgiou — lifelong best friend and brother to George Michael — began assembling the greatest collaborative album ever conceived. Eight of the most iconic artists in history all said yes. The album was never made. Until now, the footage has never been seen. This is Trojan Souls — the film that tells the story of what almost was.

title: RISE
overview: The year is 2099. With the evolution of AI bringing machines to a superior to human intelligence they have lived peacefully and in harmony together. Until now…

title: Tethered
overview: Ayden, a man grappling with a fractured conscience, finds himself at the mercy of a methodical psychiatrist who pushes his unorthodox tactics to the extreme.

title: I'm in Love with a Stripper
original_title: I'm in Love with a Stripper
overview: Alone on Christmas Eve, Michael makes a last-ditch effort to win back his ex-girlfriend. Although repelled by his sudden reappearance, the promise of $1000 buys ten minutes of Honey’s time as she reluctantly sits through his declaration of love. Michael’s dreams of a heartfelt reunion are shattered when he is promptly rejected by a stripper who refuses to participate in his fantasy, challenging toxic romantic comedy tropes normalized through contemporary media. Based on her semi-autobiographical stage play, Never Walk Alone, Julie Phan offers a desensationalized interpretation of sex work through an intimate representation of the person underneath the projection.

title: The Unmaking
overview: Esteemed genius and award-winning arthouse filmmaker Josef Balée's attempt at crafting the most ambitious and pretentious film of his career.

title: Coconut Valley
overview: A washed-up video game developer reunites with his estranged brother in Thailand in order to chase their late father's dream of uncovering a long-lost treasure.

title: Only Good Feelings
overview: Benny is haunted by guilt after his fiance dies in a car accident. In his spiral, he reconnects with Kam, a troubled childhood friend who pulls him into robbery and fraud, a desperate plan to flee to Mexico and leave their lives behind.

title: Bro
overview: Summer 2024 was an unforgettable time when many found the dream to become famous—including Lukas, whose cousin decided it was the perfect moment to make a move. But as they plunge into the world of ambition and pop culture, they face the ultimate question: at what cost?

title: Justice
overview: The online child safety taskforce, "Predator Puncherz", document their latest and most infamous sting operation.

title: Asesino Perfecto
overview: A peaceful town is gripped by fear when a series of mysterious murders leaves investigators with no witnesses, no evidence, and no clear suspect. As each new victim is discovered, Captain Rocio Cortes and Detective Soto race to stop a killer who always seems one step ahead. Their investigation uncovers hidden secrets, broken family ties, and painful events from the past that connect several lives in unexpected ways. As suspicion shifts from one person to another, two brothers, Leo and Elias, find themselves at the center of a mystery that will test their loyalty and force them to confront the truth. With fear spreading throughout the community and trust quickly fading, the search for justice becomes a dangerous race against time in this suspenseful Mexican crime thriller filled with mystery, psychological tension, and unexpected twists.

title: Outback Dale
overview: After a social media meltdown, a middle aged man embarks on a wild journey to restore his reputation.

title: The Stranger at the Door
overview: A grief-stricken recluse living in isolation after the death of his lover takes in a stranded traveler during a violent storm, unaware that the stranger is an ancient entity that feeds on the very trauma he has spent years trying to bury.

title: Kidz See Ghosts Too
overview: Two college graduates face a mysterious earthly creature with the power to change their lives.

title: Faithless
overview: After a personal loss, Savannah’s grief begins to distort her perception of reality. As she tries to understand what she is experiencing, her sense of faith, memory, and truth begins to break down.

title: The Cowboy Killer
overview: When a delusional killer in a cowboy costume starts treating a small town like his personal shooting range, two bumbling detectives must track him down and free his captive bride before he kills again.

title: Free Wifi
overview: Davi, an online motorcycle taxi driver, fakes a wealthy image on social media to attract Grace's attention. Their relationship is opposed by Grace's ex-fiancé, who hires a detective to uncover Davi's true identity. The revelation of the truth triggers a series of misunderstandings, conflicts, and chaos involving both families.

title: Mones
overview: Cici, a trans woman, confronts her gender dysphoria at her younger brother Teddy’s fraternity during a historic Pride party/drag show she put together with her best friends. As the drag performers, frat boys, and queers mingle, Cici has a romantic encounter with a familiar young man that leads to her overcoming her mental hurdles around being a woman. Ultimately, she learns the universal truth of womanhood… sometimes your titties just hurt! A high energy comedy that explores questions of identity.

title: Mosquito Halo
overview: Police investigate Dream Harvester, a political faction opposing the digitization of consciousness.

title: Compliment Sandwich
overview: A couple, over the hump of the honeymoon period, moves into a more serious state of communication in their sexual relationship.

title: What Was She Thinking
overview: Four close friends, all proudly childfree women, take on every question the world throws at them with honesty, humor, and zero apologies.

title: Everything I Own
overview: As his parents prepare to divorce and sell the home he grew up in, filmmaker Andrew Garbus turns the camera on his family and himself, unearthing long buried trauma, unresolved guilt, and the elusive hope of healing over one agonizing, revelatory week.

title: Days that Shocked the World: Concorde Crash
original_title: Days that Shocked the World: Concorde Crash
overview: Concorde was an icon of the skies, but on 25 July 2000, Air France Flight 4590 left Paris for New York and caught fire during take-off before crashing to the ground just over a minute later, killing everyone on board. The tragedy brought an end to the dream of supersonic passenger flight. But what caused the disaster? Investigators, survivors’ loved ones and those who examined the wreckage recall the tragedy and describe how the evidence led to a shockingly simple conclusion about what went wrong.

title: The Disconnection
overview: Luke is pressured by a pair of stereotypical bullies to get a new phone, so he enlists the help of his unpredictable, dumb friend Liam, but their mission quickly spirals into chaos when a pair of rich, phone-obsessed twins enter the classroom, turning a simple task into a ridiculous, absurd adventure.

title: Ends Meat
overview: A woman is confronted with the realization that she's misunderstood the meaning of a common phrase.

title: The Last DIY Show
overview: When a zombie apocalypse breaks out at a punk show, young show photographer Dahlia, her friends, and ex-boyfriend must band together to make it out alive.

title: El Draa
overview: Beneath Chioggia's modern port, memories of the last sea dragon vibrate the lagoon. Above, a summer of work and silence unfolds, on an increasingly weary sea.

title: Valley of the Horntak
overview: During their search in the woods for a missing boy, an estranged father and son encounter a sinister cult who worship mind and flesh altering creatures.

title: Rabani
overview: “Rabani” – is a film about Ukrainian refugee with Sudanese roots, who is caught between memory and a relentless media stream that constructs a parallel life inside his mind. As he moves through Berlin, this mediated reality begins to distort his perception, until he can no longer distinguish which emotions are his own and which are imposed.

title: The End of The End
overview: Courageous throughout her life, a woman is no less defiant when it concludes. In the underworld, Death manifests before her in myriad forms, each with a bargain to strike. Death may have met its match, though.

title: Something Borrowed
overview: On the morning of her wedding, a bride does anything it takes to fit into her wedding dress.

title: I Stared The Devil In The Eye
original_title: I Stared The Devil In The Eye
overview: Three seemingly unconnected lives become intertwined through a series of  unexpected events, forcing each person to confront the consequences of their choices. As the truth begins to surface, everything changes in ways they never saw coming.

title: The Hunted
overview: Three deadly stories of pursuit collide in this horror-thriller anthology: a concussed runner and her dog are stalked in the wilderness, a serial killer targets an abusive man, and bank robbers turn on one another over a priceless score.

title: Glorious Disaster
overview: Documentary on Laurel & Hardy by David Cairns and Fiona Watson

title: IP
overview: Due to overpopulation, the internet is collapsing under the weight of IP addresses belonging to deceased people. As a result, a system is introduced to purge and delete their accounts based on official death records. However, one account linked to a registered death shows recent activity, prompting the protagonist to reach out to its owner.

title: Before the Coffee
overview: Naw Paw visits her boyfriend, Ko Phone for what should be a joyful week together. But as unspoken frustrations, conflicting dreams, and the fear of separation surface, their relationship is tested in ways neither of them expects.

title: Amy Winehouse: The Tragic Downfall
overview: A documentary that delves into the life, career, and struggles of iconic British singer and songwriter Amy Winehouse. Through the archival footage, interviews with those who knew her and expert analysis, the film explores Amy's quick rise to fame, her battles with addiction and mental health issues, and the pressure of celebrity culture. It offers a poignant reflection on the music industry's impact on artists and devastating consequences of unchecked fame.

title: Amityville Alone
overview: Meet Ricky, an 8 year old boy neglected by his father. When Santa forgets to put his presents under the tree, Ricky gets granted three Christmas miracles by the Tree Witch. He wishes to be BIG, he wishes to be HOME ALONE, and finally, he wishes for his E.T.special friend Tito to go from being a dog to a full speaking humanoid. But once Ricky gets in trouble with a local gangster, he and Tito will have to fight for their right... to party!

title: HappyDeal
overview: In the near future, a struggling single mother living out of her car with her young daughter sees a life-changing opportunity when a global online retail giant launches a hiring initiative for people in need. After an unexpected setback threatens her chances, she's offered an experimental alternative that could secure her future, but at a cost she never anticipated.

title: He'll Never Find Me
overview: After fleeing an abusive marriage and faking her own death, a woman builds a new life on a farm in a quiet Midwestern town—until a viral video exposes her identity.

title: Anaganaga O Sukravaram
overview: After the loss of her father, Meghana buries herself in work while her overprotective mother, Lakshmi, tries to control every aspect of her life. But when a mysterious twist swaps their bodies for a day, the mother-daughter duo are forced to live each other's struggles, secrets, and emotions. As chaos turns into understanding, one question remains: what caused the swap in the first place?

title: The Art of Quitting Gracefully
overview: When 41-year-old NYC teacher Joan Cantrell quits her job to finally write the novel she's been avoiding, she's haunted by more than her deadline: her mother also tried to become a writer, and killed herself when she failed.

title: Hallway Monitor
overview: George's sister is sick. Trying his best to take care of her, the twelve year old boy spends all hospital visits inspecting the hallway for anything that might put her in danger. When his routine inspection is interrupted, George must face the danger all around him.

title: Prompt: Make a Documentary
overview: Prompt: Make a Documentary investigates the growing influence of artificial intelligence on the film industry.  The documentary places the rise of AI within the broader historical context of cinema’s evolution, drawing parallels with earlier technological shifts such as the introduction of sound, colour, and digital visual effects. By revisiting landmark moments in film history, the film demonstrates that disruption has always been part of cinema’s DNA, while questioning whether AI represents a fundamentally different kind of change.  Featuring insights from directors, academics, and practitioners, Prompt: Make a Documentary explores the tension between innovation and integrity, the democratisation of creative tools, and the ethical implications of automation in the arts. The film ultimately asks whether artificial intelligence will empower the next generation of storytellers or redefine creativity itself.

title: Singer
overview: While recording vocal takes alone in a deserted carpark, an anxious singer confronts the shadows outside and the fear within.

title: Auditoria
overview: In an audition room, Zephyr and June reunite with their past flickering behind. Exchanging dozens of faces and double the glances, they seek to find something to grip within each other. Something that will help to convince, to persuade, to plead. One's truth over the other's.

title: HER SECOND ACT
original_title: HER SECOND ACT (她妈的叛逆中年)
overview: Sandra, a middle-aged mother, has long devoted herself to her family, quietly setting aside parts of herself that once felt alive. When she inherits her late brother's bicycle, an impulsive ride leads to an unexpected victory. This sudden recognition begins to unsettle the stillness of her carefully ordered life. As attention grows, the delicate balance within her marriage begins to shift. Long-suppressed dreams, disappointments, and silences between Sandra and her husband rise to the surface, unsettling the roles they have long taken for granted. Caught between the family and the pull of desire, Sandra is drawn into a disorienting second act, where change arrives uninvited, bringing both possibility and consequence for both husband, wife and family.

title: The Lonely Child
overview: Eighty years after the Holocaust, the daughter of the writer of a haunting Yiddish lullaby traces the song's origin and impact over generations.

title: Beacon of Flesh
overview: A doomed transgender creature becomes psychically entangled with a medieval nun in this Super 8 rock opera.

title: EZ Driver
overview: Miguel Matias, a laid-back EZ driver coasting through life, hits an unexpected breaking point when he picks up Ruby Valentine, a suspicious passenger with secrets that attract the wrong kind of attention. What begins as a routine ride escalates into a dangerous chain reaction that pulls Miguel into her trouble, forcing him to navigate rising threats, split-second choices, and a night that pushes him far beyond his comfort zone.

title: What Krishna Saw
overview: A documentary exploring the relationship between devotion, dairy, and modern Hindu practice through the lens of Krishna consciousness in contemporary India.  In the excuse of God, we have institutionalized a contradiction. "What Krishna Saw" investigates the profound disconnect between the ancient, revered sanctity of the cow in Hindu tradition and the stark realities of the modern, industrial dairy complex that fuels today's rituals.

title: 3:03 AM
overview: At 3:03 AM, Michelle hears sounds coming from inside her bedroom.

title: Aria-Remix
overview: When struggling DJ Aria (Bonnie Hill) is targeted by a mysterious cult, she finds herself possessed by an ancient Lovecraftian deity who uses her music as a portal to enter our world and consume our reality.

title: JAWBREAKER
overview: A year after a deadly prank that left a helpless student scarred, a group of sorority sisters must face the terrifying consequence when a masked killer returns during their annual Spring Bash, picking them off one by one in a weekend of unrelenting terror.

title: Vietnam: Kill Zone
overview: During the Tet Offensive, a battle-weary combat photographer joins a battered U.S. platoon on a deadly jungle mission where survival becomes secondary to the political agenda behind their orders.

title: Goodbye, Monster
overview: A 12-year-old boy receives one final visit from the creature under his bed, forcing him to confront fear, loss, and the emotional cost of growing up.

title: The Measure of a Man
overview: In 1980s Northeast Atlanta, a young boy's understanding of manhood is shaped by his cousin Michael, a man who leaves his past behind and quietly teaches love, courage, and self-acceptance through his presence in the family. As generational anger and old wounds resurface, the boy must decide what kind of man he intends to become.

title: The Man in the Second Story Window
original_title: The Man in the Second Story Window
overview: A Man sits at a desk, typing. Another Man sits across from him in a chair, sleeping. Outside, beneath them, reality plays out, as it has forever. Today, however, that changes.

title: Down the Long River
overview: In the aftermath of the Civil War, a former Army surgeon, a notorious gang, and a duplicitous Pinkerton agent cross paths in a tiny river town. When revenge and a fortune in gold are at stake, the town is caught in the crossfire.

title: EROS
overview: Beatriz is trapped in a vicious cycle where she doesn’t feel seen. All of that changes once she meets Sofia.

title: American Flake
overview: A small-town drug dealer avoids grieving the death of his mom by searching for a lost bag of his favorite potato chips.

title: Have You Seen My Gods?
overview: Amitabh sets out to locate the stolen gods of Kathmandu fulfilling his grandmother’s final wish.

title: High Voltage
overview: Over the course of a single night in the Far Rockaways, two teenage girls drift toward an intimacy that neither can fully name, blurring the line between friendship and desire.

title: Landship
overview: The Battle of Passchendaele, 1917. For three years the great war has been waging, and the two armies find themselves entrenched along the four-hundred-mile Western Front. At the start of a pivotal allied offensive to break the stalemate, the nine-man crew of a British MKIV Tank set out to destroy a series of heavily defended German bunkers.

title: Soldier's Bones
overview: In 1971 reporter Alec Shimkin discovers a secret US-led military campaign: Operation Speedy Express. This discovery may reveal war crimes on an immense scale. Yet nobody knows about Alec’s scoop, who went missing-in-action in Vietnam himself. In Alec’s footsteps, Soldier’s Bones searches for Speedy’s deadly echo in the Mekong Delta.

title: Sh(Out)
overview: After 20 years of marriage, a 43-year-old mother takes to the open road, exploring her identity, quiet courage, and the longing to be seen—not just as a parent or partner, but as herself.

title: Signed, Sealed & Delivered: Inside the Billion-Dollar World of Sports Collectibles
original_title: Signed, Sealed & Delivered: Inside the Billion-Dollar World of Sports Collectibles
overview: What was once considered a childhood hobby has evolved into a billion-dollar global marketplace. Signed, Sealed & Delivered takes audiences inside the high-stakes world of sports collectibles, where rare trading cards, signed jerseys, and historic memorabilia have become status symbols, emotional investments, and financial assets. Through exclusive access, interviews, and behind-the-scenes footage, the documentary explores the personalities and businesses driving the hobby's modern explosion. Featuring appearances and commentary tied to sports and business icons including Lionel Messi, Kevin O'Leary, and Gary Vaynerchuk, the film uncovers the culture, psychology, risks, and financial opportunities behind the booming collectibles industry — while asking what people are truly chasing when they spend fortunes trying to own a piece of sports history.

title: ZsaZsa Zaturnnah vs The Amazonistas of Planet X
original_title: ZsaZsa Zaturnnah vs The Amazonistas of Planet X
overview: Ada is a shy gay man living in a small town in the Philippines. After many heartbreaks over many years, he has committed himself to a simple and single life. But when a magical stone from outer space transforms him into a flamboyant female superhero, Ada is forced to face fantastic challenges. From fighting zombies to stopping invading Amazonistas from Planet X, to the even more difficult task of risking his heart to love again.

title: Luna
overview: With the moon hurtling toward Earth and the world unraveling, one woman's quiet descent into solitude mirrors the chaos above.  As doomsday approaches, Selene-adrift in grief and silence-finds an unexpected connection in the sky's slow collapse. A haunting, poetic journey through memory and meaning, The Award winning Luna is a meditative tale of endings, and the peace we find when we stop running from them.

title: Beliath
overview: While reporting on a brutal murder, a small-town TV crew uncovers a hidden cult whose secrets were never meant to be filmed.

title: Married Alive
overview: Single dad Mack & his soon-to-be-married son Tony may not survive their off-road camping trip when their Jeep overturns, trapping Tony underneath. With a storm coming, Mack has to find help to save his son from drowning.

title: Let Us Be
overview: An intimate portrait of Intersex individuals born with sex anatomy not typically male or female, across India, Brazil, and the USA. Through personal stories, the film exposes the ongoing human rights struggle against non-consensual surgeries performed on intersex children, while confronting the rigid binaries that shape our understanding of sex and gender. "Let Us Be" invites audiences to reconsider the norms imposed on bodies and identities, offering a reflection on autonomy, dignity, and the beauty of human diversity.

title: Oliver West
overview: West Knight secretly helps Oliver, a ghost only she can see, cross over to the afterlife before his spiritual essence deteriorates completely. While her step sibling Jaime navigates a new romance with coworker Quinn, West discovers that Oliver's unfinished business isn't about supernatural rituals—it's about experiencing human connection and love.

title: 7 Piano Sketches
overview: A piano tuner wanders through the streets of New York after dark, seeking artistic inspiration. Sketchbook in hand, he observes the city’s lovers, mourners, and giant ants from afar. But when a twist of fate brings him face-to-face with a kindred spirit, he finds what he was looking for all along.

title: Our Effed Up World
overview: Sheri thought her biggest problem in life was dealing with the recent loss of her beloved grandma.  But when a mysterious entity crash lands in the woods, only she and her group of shitkicker friends are what stands in the way of an insatiable, intergalactic hunger.

title: Jaap van Zweden dirige Mozart, Stravinsky et Betsy Jolas
original_title: Jaap van Zweden dirige Mozart, Stravinsky et Betsy Jolas
overview: To mark his return to the Radio France Philharmonic Orchestra, Jaap van Zweden will conduct works by Mozart, Stravinsky and Betsy Jolas. With *The Rite of Spring* as the highlight, the concert spans music from more than two centuries.

title: Then You Said It
overview: Two best friends realise they both have feelings for each other. But will they confess? And what will happen if they do?

title: RUN AWAY AND HIDE
overview: The New Zealand Government has issued a warning to stay indoors and avoid anyone unfamiliar.

title: MEATLOAF
overview: "Is 10lb of meat enough for a good size meatloaf?"

title: Return of the Clowns
overview: In a new ESPN E60 special debuting on the Juneteenth holiday, a vibrant, deeply human, and joyfully cinematic documentary chronicles the extraordinary journey of the Indianapolis Clowns – once icons of Negro League baseball, now reborn for a new generation through the electric world of Banana Ball.

title: La maldición del sauce
overview: A documentary about the city of Quilmes.

title: Node
overview: A poignant exploration of childhood illness, resilience, and family.

title: Goodbye to All That
overview: In a dusty apartment, Gabo mourns the end of a difficult relationship. Soon, reality gives way to a dreamlike delirium…

title: Stepfather
overview: After years of eradicating any family that falls short of perfection, Darnell believes his new wife Asia and her daughters might finally be the real deal. That is, until tensions rise and they uncover his deadly pattern. Now, getting rid of them won’t be as easy as he planned.

title: Four Itchy Boys
overview: Four young men quarantined for a unexplainable, unrelenting itch prepare for a live-stream press event to prove they’re not the monsters the world believes them to be. But behind the scenes, a ruthless producer is plotting a more grotesque spectacle.

title: Citizen Vigilante
overview: A man takes justice into his own hands, hunting down criminals. His vigilante crusade makes him a social media star but puts him at odds with the local police chief.

title: Routine
overview: A repetitive day of a teenager who has dreams that represents a more peaceful and fulfilling life that they’d like to have.

title: Assets & Liabilities
overview: Zach is a suburban father haunted by the impending arrival of middle age as he juggles the demands of work, family, and the sale of an investment property. When his wife and daughter go away for a short trip, he seizes the opportunity to live out a day as his younger, less responsible self. A spontaneous encounter with a fellow skater feels like a victory until an unsettling connection between the two emerges. The result is a forcible confrontation with his own bourgeois standing that shatters the illusion of Zach’s carefree day and sends it spiraling into dark territory.

title: Synthesized
overview: Martyn is a man out of time who loves his wife Valkyrie, computers and synthesizers, which he plays in pubs and clubs to unappreciative audiences. But when Val does him wrong and Martyn's life starts to fall apart he retreats into his music, hoping to calm his inner turmoil.  But music can summon the dark as well as soothe the soul, and it's not long before Martyn is hitting more than just the keys on his synthesizer keyboard.

title: Forbidden Fruits
overview: Free Eden employee Apple secretly runs a witchy femme cult in the basement of the mall store after hours - with fellow fruits Cherry and Fig. But when new hire Pumpkin challenges their performative sisterhood, the women are forced to face their own poisons or succumb to a bloody fate.

title: A Force Of Nature
overview: Mikey is alone in his house, he doesn't realise that someone from his past is about to confront him. Someone who believes themself to be A Force Of Nature.

title: 48 Hours
overview: When sophomore Tyler Cameron vanishes without a trace, his roommate Brandon James receives a chilling warning: he has 48 hours to find him… or to discover what’s left. Every hour brings new threats, new clues, and the terrifying realization that someone is watching Brandon’s every move.

title: New York Movie
overview: A dough-eyed newcomer to New York is sent on a mental spiral of his own self-worth when he is asked to take photos of a random couple in a park and he finds out what it truly means to be a New Yorker.

title: Stockholm
overview: A young woman’s exploration of BDSM takes a dangerous turn when she’s abducted, forcing her to confront the boundaries between desire, consent and control.

title: Their Town
overview: When Abby’s boyfriend unexpectedly drops out of the high school play, she is forced to help outlier Matt step into the role opposite her. Over the course of a long night wandering their small town, the two examine their futures and unearth surprises from their past.

title: Born to Lose
overview: A young biker grapples with his father's troubled legacy and escalating debts to a local gangster. As he races to restore a vintage motorcycle to save himself, he must confront family secrets and forge his own identity.

title: Stormbound
overview: An intimate look at Jeff Gammons, a chronically ill man who finds peace and beauty chasing the world's largest hurricanes.

title: Serena
overview: Desperate to launch her company into the future with resounding success, a CEO commissions tech engineer Holly  to build her an AI model. However, before being implemented it must be tested. Down-on-his-luck and funds, former rock star, Chris Sadowsky, is asked to be one of the testers — with devastating repercussions.

title: Storm Rider: Legend of Hammerhead
overview: Centuries after the Great Flood, riders compete in death races on the water to secure shelter for their people behind the walls of Argos. Rebellious storm riders Neb and Ana look to uncover hidden truths by breaking through the storm.

title: Kill Me
overview: Jimmy wakes up in a bathtub after having tried to kill himself. Or, at least, that’s what it looks like to his friends and family. Jimmy is pretty sure he didn’t do it… maybe. Together with Margot, the 911 operator who took his call, Jimmy sets out on a mission to solve a vitally important whodunit: did someone try to kill him, or are they chasing the spectre of depression?

title: Spaghetti
overview: A group of youths at a recreational center take part in a dance game.

title: Phantom of the Dojo
overview: Drew's dad owns a dojo. She's a pretty good boxer... her boyfriend, Freddie, isn't so the two sneak a practice in after hours. Drew's a tough girl but tonight she broke down into a million pieces. She became the punching bag... to thin air? Distraught she runs away and drops her keys in the process. Freddie picks them up and hides them away... she has the car started and is begging Freddie to jump ship with her. Freddie doesn't disobey - he runs after but feels goosebumps at the door. There's something there and Freddie's gonna kick its ass someway, somehow.

title: Mendocino
overview: A lawyer faces ancestral violence and haunting memories in a California farmhouse, exploring guilt and redemption.

title: Minutes
overview: Sera, a 9-5 office worker, realizes that her time is short after an emergency broadcast plays at her office.

title: GO
overview: A young woman is followed home by a hooded figure.

title: Geoff Capes: Britain's Greatest Strongman
overview: Celebrating the life and legacy of one of Britain's greatest athletes.

title: Ken Dodd: The Lost Tapes
overview: Featuring unseen footage, as well as some of Sir Ken Dodd's finest work on television.

title: Lemonade
overview: A conversation sparks.

title: Brampton Batman
overview: Patrolling the streets at night, Brampton Batman proves that you don't need violence to make a difference.

title: Callan Kicks the Year 2025
overview: Callan Kicks the Year dips through all the maddest moments in Ireland and abroad in 2025.

title: Cables
overview: Stop motion short of powerlines

title: Mantiram's Ring 1¾: War For Mantiram
overview: Following the events of Skepna's death, Mantiram makes his grand return. Ghanti and Friends must say goodbye to a bridge, trees, and stuff, prepare for war and make their final stand.

title: spinning flower
overview: some time, october 2024. me and my friend (rei) filmed some shots regarding plants, flowers, grass and trees. i forgot about it soon enough. it’s been a year since then, and i wanted to give it a home.

title: Making Wicked: For Good
overview: Return to Oz for a fantastic behind-the-scenes journey with this expansive look inside the characters, choreography, and creativity that make up the movie's unforgettable world.

title: Evil Influencer: The Jodi Hildebrandt Story
original_title: Evil Influencer: The Jodi Hildebrandt Story
overview: Unravel the case of Utah therapist Jodi Hildebrandt, whose child abuse arrest with parenting YouTuber Ruby Franke exposed a twisted tale of manipulation.

title: A Perfect Bite
overview: Paul reconciles with his past through baking.

title: Work A Lot
overview: In Work A Lot, Memphis Depay steps off the pitch and into the daily lives of the people who keep São Paulo moving. The mini-documentary weaves interviews with Brazilian workers — from street vendors to truck drivers, from bakers to hairdressers — with behind-the-scenes moments of Depay’s own life in Brazil, spanning music, football, and visits to local communities. Stripped of glamour and filters, the film connects different realities through a shared truth: working hard isn’t a lifestyle choice, it’s survival. A raw, urban and honest portrait of daily struggle, belonging, and real life.

title: Eudaimonia
overview: When Isaac, a young teen struggling with his self-worth, finds a new identity as popular singer-songwriter Ace Duncan, in an unconscious attempt to save himself from his depression.

title: Next Stop
overview: Travelling by train, a group of friends' holiday ends in real time.
